column4: Hollywood-style warm highlights and cool shadows.
High-contrast, low-saturation, blue-shifted shadows.
Warm sunset glow with extra red and yellow.
Cool blue-dominant night-time palette.
Faded, slightly desaturated film with a vignette.
Classic brownish sepia via channel mixer.
Saturation to zero, contrast pushed to 1.4.
Half-saturation, high-contrast bleach-bypass look.
Green-tinted low-light look with strong noise.
Heavy grain with a subtle vignette.
Channel-mixed cross-processed look.
Bright, low-contrast dreamy highlight look.
Invert all colors (film negative).
Sobel-style wireframe edge detection.
Quantize each color channel to 3 bits — 8 levels per channel.
Grain + vertical jitter + vignette + warm grade + occasional white flash.
Grain + random vertical white lines. Damaged film look.
Color-channel mix that biases the image toward a heat palette (warm reds and yellows).
Green-channel boost + grain + vignette + slight blur. Night-vision goggles look.
Posterize + edge detect + composite edges over the flattened colors. The cel-shaded comic look.
Heavy box blur + unsharp + posterize. Imitates an oil-paint surface.
Posterize + geq dot pattern. Mimics newspaper halftone printing.
Map luminance onto two chosen colors via color-channel mixer. Black shadow → blue midtones → cyan highlight.
Invert the upper half of the tonal range. Classic photographic effect.
Edge detect with colormix mode + saturation boost + gaussian-blur bloom. A glowing edge look.
Bright areas bleed color. Boost saturation + add a soft blur for a bloom look.
Split horizontally, hflip the right half, and hstack the two halves.
